parole.significato: ablution (the rinsing of the priest's hand and the sacred vessel following the Communion)
parole.testo: From Late Latin ablūtiō (“washing, cleansing, ablution”), from abluō (“to wash off, cleanse”), from both ab- (“from, away from, off”), from ab (“from, away from, on, in”), from Proto-Italic *ab, from Proto-Indo-European *h₂epó (“off, away”), and from lavō (“to wash, bathe; wet, moisten”), from Proto
